projects.title: My Projects
projects.project1Description: A learning management system: groups, disciplines, students, Google Calendar sync. React frontend, microservices backend (Node.js/Express), Supabase, Docker.
projects.project2Description: Forked an open-source hh.ru auto-apply tool and extended it into a full system: LinkedIn integration, Telegram-based auth and logging, AI-generated cover letters, Docker/systemd/cron deployment.
projects.project3Description: A web app for one-click bulk applications on hh.ru. Archived: hh.ru revoked the free API access the backend relied on.
projects.project4Description: Contributed fixes to the open-source AI assistant Pluely: an OpenRouter fallback chain for provider outages, a proxy-aware network layer, and a window-positioning fix for Wayland/XWayland. Opened a PR upstream.
projects.project5Description: Console automation for daily sales-team reconciliation: matches deals in amoCRM by email and checks WhatsApp channel status in Revvy via Puppeteer.
projects.project6Description: A console script that parses a school timetable website and tallies teacher hours over a period into a CSV file for review.
